raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Since the 2026-01-15 rollout, the v2 collector emits txn_ts in UTC while legacy emits America/Chicago local time, and silver mixes the two. v2 evening transactions land in the early-morning hours of the next date (36 rows on 01-19, all before 05:00), and v2 times such as 12:00 UTC are really 06:00 local. The fix converts v2 timestamps to Chicago local time, which matches the historical legacy semantics.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.82,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(x.local_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(x.local_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN timezone('America/Chicago', timezone('UTC', CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP))) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS local_ts FROM raw_transactions) x WHERE x.status = 'POSTED'"}}
